configure terminal

Enter configuration commands, one per line. End with CNTL/Z.

host01(config)# ip route 198.51.100.0/24 192.0.2.250


host01(config)# ipv6 route 2001:db8::/32 2001:db8:ffff::fe


host01(config)# interface loopback 900


host01(config-if)# no ip address 192.0.2.222/32


host01(config-if)# ip address 192.0.2.223/32


host01(config-if)# no ipv6 address 2001:db8:900::1/128


host01(config-if)# ipv6 address 2001:db8:900::2/128


host01(config-if)# exit


host01(config)# end


host01#
